steps.label: Unlock
steps.text: Increases the wearer's Spiritual PEN by 10%. After casting the Ultimate, the wearer's ATK is permanently increased by 5%, stacking up to 15%.

steps.label: 5★ Blue
steps.text: Increases the wearer's Spiritual PEN by 20%. After casting the Ultimate, the wearer's ATK is permanently increased by 10%, stacking up to 30%.

steps.label: 5★ Yellow
steps.text: Increases the wearer's Spiritual PEN by 30%. After casting the Ultimate, the wearer's ATK is permanently increased by 15%, stacking up to 45%.

guide.text: Constantine's signature gear. Its universal skill increases Spiritual Penetration and Attack, enhancing his spiritual damage. Its exclusive skill boosts his active skills with additional AoE damage. With the scaling damage mechanics, Constantine deals devastating AoE damage after his second Ultimate.
